useful_pattern: One primary document-signing action is presented with minimal acquisition friction.
risk_or_weakness: The client-rendered landing exposes little crawlable copy, so it is not a technical SEO model by itself.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Lead with the PDF result and keep the workflow focused on the current tab.
not_applied: Do not claim free use, no signup, user totals, or signature-product benefits without Page 2 PDF evidence.

useful_pattern: Benefit-led opening, before-and-after framing, role-specific use cases, and measured case results make the workflow concrete.
risk_or_weakness: Several benefits and AI claims repeat across a long page; client growth figures are not product-user growth.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Explain each PDF mode through the job it completes and keep sections outcome-led.
not_applied: Do not copy AI hype, repeated productivity claims, or unrelated client metrics.

useful_pattern: The opening names the exact transfer, included content, three steps, pricing boundaries, and unsupported content.
risk_or_weakness: The page is long and tied to an emerging platform; copying its breadth would create unsupported claims.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: State supported chat content, the three-step export flow, and clear adapter boundaries.
not_applied: Do not imply channel migration, background synchronization, or unsupported messenger coverage.

useful_pattern: The category-led title and subtitle state the task directly, followed by concrete coverage and no-signup information.
risk_or_weakness: Feature density and broad marketing language can obscure the first-use job.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Use a task-led Store title and factual screenshots for each output mode.
not_applied: Do not claim geographic coverage, property data, or no-signup benefits that do not belong to Page 2 PDF.

useful_pattern: The page gives a specific result, time-to-value, three steps, proof points, and a working tool before long educational copy.
risk_or_weakness: Testimonials, learner totals, and free positioning require independent verification before reuse.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Put the export result first, use three steps, and show verified sample PDFs.
not_applied: Do not invent user counts, testimonials, ratings, free pricing, or instant-result guarantees.

useful_pattern: Exact browser-call positioning, concrete prerequisites, three steps, transparent limits, and route-specific pages answer one intent at a time.
risk_or_weakness: Location-page repetition and testimonial claims require careful evidence and can become thin at scale.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Describe the active-tab workflow and concrete supported use cases before implementation details.
not_applied: Do not copy pricing, testimonials, global coverage, or route-page scale.

useful_pattern: The founder prioritizes one useful result within about 30 seconds and reports native Reddit posts, replacement outreach, backlinks, and specific SEO routes.
risk_or_weakness: Channel attribution is founder-reported and does not prove that copy alone caused growth.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Make the first two sentences explain the export result and keep acquisition claims evidence-based.
not_applied: Do not repeat revenue, conversion, or traffic claims as Page 2 PDF proof.

useful_pattern: The title and opening use the exact HTML-to-PDF task and list recognizable archiving and sharing use cases.
risk_or_weakness: The description repeats keywords unnaturally and promises URL upload, batch conversion, and other workflows that Page 2 PDF does not provide.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Use HTML/webpage-to-PDF language once in a factual active-tab explanation.
not_applied: Do not copy keyword stuffing, pasted-URL, upload, batch, free, or online-converter claims.

useful_pattern: A working tool appears before explanatory content and the first heading states the exact use case.
risk_or_weakness: The lower page repeatedly defines overlapping chat-bot concepts and becomes longer than the user task requires.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Put the result and install action before supporting detail and keep each section informationally distinct.
not_applied: Do not copy free/no-signup claims, excessive definitions, or generic AI explanations.

useful_pattern: The title combines a known platform with one immediately legible browser action.
risk_or_weakness: The body repeats the same keyword and makes broad eye-strain, battery, uniqueness, and cross-device claims.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Name supported services only in a factual adapter list and keep the main promise platform-neutral.
not_applied: Do not imply affiliation or copy repetitive trademark, health, battery, or superlative claims.

useful_pattern: The overview names the task, target roles, key features, and a four-step workflow.
risk_or_weakness: Benefits and audiences repeat across many sections without adding new decision information.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Explain the three output modes and three export steps without an audience laundry list.
not_applied: Do not repeat productivity, accuracy, workflow, or professional-quality claims in multiple sections.

useful_pattern: The title pairs a platform with the exact transformation, followed by quick-start steps and concrete uses.
risk_or_weakness: The listing is emoji-heavy, repeats the transformation many times, and makes broad privacy and capability claims.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Use factual service-to-PDF phrases and one short three-step workflow.
not_applied: Do not copy emojis, repetitive reasons-to-choose lists, universal support, or unverified privacy claims.
duplicate_input_note: The same URL appeared twice in the provided reference list and was analyzed once.

useful_pattern: The title and FAQ expose a recognizable ChatGPT-plus-PDF intent.
risk_or_weakness: The description relies on ultimate/revolutionize language, repeated AI promises, grammar errors, and features unrelated to Page 2 PDF.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Use the exact factual phrase ChatGPT to PDF in the supported-export list.
not_applied: Do not copy AI summarization, document chat, annotation, upload, accuracy, or transformation hype.

useful_pattern: A short integration-led title makes the platform and destination clear.
risk_or_weakness: The body is vague about the actual workflow and leans on generic business and productivity promises.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Use supported platform names only where the corresponding export adapter exists.
not_applied: Do not use generic business-growth, productivity, revolution, or download-now language.

useful_pattern: The listing uses a plain utility category instead of an abstract brand-only promise.
risk_or_weakness: The provided Store page was not consistently extractable, so detailed copy conclusions would be weak evidence.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Keep Page 2 PDF naming descriptive and validate every claim against the package.
not_applied: Do not import unavailable copy, usage figures, signature claims, or assumptions from the website.

useful_pattern: The overview states the recording action, basic controls, download result, three-step use, and privacy intent.
risk_or_weakness: Instructions repeat, emojis dominate scanning, and unlimited or supreme-quality claims are not sufficiently qualified.
applied_to_page_2_pdf: Keep one how-to sequence and one precise privacy statement.
not_applied: Do not copy superlatives, unlimited claims, repeated instructions, emojis, or unrelated recording use cases.
